description: This file contains event handler functions for chart interactions in Superset, including click and context menu events, with support for cross-filtering and drill-down features.

methods.name: getCrossFilterDataMask
methods.description: Generates a data mask object for cross-filtering based on selected values and label mappings.

methods.name: clickEventHandler
methods.description: Handles click events on chart elements, updating the data mask for cross-filtering if enabled.

methods.name: contextMenuEventHandler
methods.description: Handles right-click (context menu) events, triggering drill-down filters and cross-filtering actions.

methods.name: allEventHandlers
methods.description: Aggregates and returns all event handlers (click and context menu) based on transformed chart properties.
